title: Agent skill: /reactor-project — Use when working in a Powerhouse reactor package project and the Vetra development environment is not running or needs restarting — starting
content:
## When to use
Use when working in a Powerhouse reactor package project and the Vetra development environment is not running or needs restarting — starting Vetra Studio and Switchboard, capturing their endpoints, initializing a new reactor package, or shutting one down.

## What it covers
- Quick reference
- Readiness markers
- References
- Common mistakes
- RPPM.00.1 Inspect existing projects
- RPPM.00.2 Generate unique project name
- RPPM.00.3 Initialize the project
- RPPM.01.1 Start the Reactor Package project and wait until it's ready
- RPPM.01.2 Parse and verify the Vetra endpoints
- RPPM.02.1 Verify project is running
- RPPM.02.2 Shutdown the project
